staticCursorRules.description: Matt Pocock skills are global-only; never vendor them in this repo
staticCursorRules.title: Matt Pocock skills — global only
staticCursorRules.body:
- Canonical skill files live in `~/.agents/skills` (user-global). Do not vendor them under `.agents/skills/` in this repo.
- Never add `skills-lock.json` here. Upgrade globally with `node scripts/install-global-skills.mjs`.
- Never commit `agent/` or `.claude/skills/<matt-skill>/` junctions/copies from the installer; keep gitnexus skills under `.claude/skills/gitnexus/` only.
- `npm run skills:check` asserts this repo has no vendored Matt trees. See [docs/agents/skills-lock.md](../../docs/agents/skills-lock.md).
- **Always follow Matt standards** — read [docs/agents/matt-standards.md](../../docs/agents/matt-standards.md) and the matching global skill before design/review/refactor.
- Issue tracker, triage labels, and domain layout are configured in `docs/agents/` — engineering skills read those files.
- Grow domain language via `/grill-with-docs` into root `CONTEXT.md` and `docs/adr/`; do not invent empty stubs.

staticCursorRules.description: Always follow Matt Pocock global skills for design, review, refactor, and agent docs.
staticCursorRules.title: Matt standards — always apply
staticCursorRules.body:
Read **[docs/agents/matt-standards.md](../../docs/agents/matt-standards.md)** at session start for the skill map and repo-specific rules.

## Non-negotiable

- **Global skills only** (`~/.agents/skills`) — never vendor. See `.cursor/rules/matt-pocock-skills.mdc`.
- **Deep modules** — small interface, testable core. Packages via entry points; automation via `scripts/lib/`.
- **Scripts over instructions** — policy in `scripts/lib` + JSON; agent docs link, don't restate. See `.cursor/rules/scripts-over-instructions.mdc`.
- **Before editing** a module seam or reviewing a diff: read the matching global skill (`codebase-design`, `code-review`, `writing-for-agents`, `tdd`, …) from `docs/agents/matt-standards.md`.
- **Before merging** a PR: run `npm run test:pre-merge-vertical` (static + browser vertical when the diff warrants it). See [docs/agents/ci.md](../../docs/agents/ci.md).

When in doubt, read the skill file first — do not improvise a second standard.

sections.pointer: Issues live in GitHub Issues for `parthalon025/six-flags-sa` (via `gh`). Agent-handoff issues share that tracker and enter the triage label flow. See [docs/agents/issue-tracker.md](./docs/agents/issue-tracker.md).
Packages are deep modules — see [packages/README.md](./packages/README.md) before adding or importing one. Layout: [docs/repo-structure.md](./docs/repo-structure.md).

Matt Pocock skills are global (`~/.agents/skills`). This repo must not vendor them. `npm run skills:check` asserts `.agents/skills` and `skills-lock.json` are absent. See [docs/agents/skills-lock.md](./docs/agents/skills-lock.md).
Always apply the global Matt skills for design, review, refactor, and agent docs. Skill map and repo rules: [docs/agents/matt-standards.md](./docs/agents/matt-standards.md).
Always-loaded agent docs are slim pointers; full policy lives under `docs/agents/policies/`. Regenerate with `npm run agent-docs:build`; CI checks with `npm run agent-docs:check`.
